items: Testing is essential for reliable applications because it helps to: (a) Optimise code performance (b) Identify and fix bugs (c) Reduce the program size (d) Make code run faster
Common types of programming errors include: (a) Syntax error (b) Logic error (c) Runtime error (d) All of the above
Unit testing focuses on: (a) Testing the entire application (b) Testing individual components or functions (c) Testing the user interface (d) Testing database connections
The Python module used for unit testing is: (a) numpy (b) matplotlib (c) unittest (d) os
The main purpose of using testing tools like unittest and pytest: (a) to increase program size (b) to verify code works correctly (c) to design layouts (d) to compile programs
Breakpoints in debugging are used to: (a) Run the program faster (b) Pause the program at specific points and inspect its state (c) Skip certain code sections (d) Optimise the code
Watch expressions in debugging are used to: (a) Change variable values (b) Monitor variable values during program execution (c) Pause the program (d) Display output messages
Step-by-step debugging is used to: (a) Run the program faster (b) Execute code one line at a time for easier error identification (c) Increase the program's performance (d) Compile the code
The Python keyword pair used for exception handling is: (a) try-except (b) try-finally (c) try-catch (d) handle-throw
Profiling in programming is used to: (a) Improve the user interface design (b) Measure performance and identify bottlenecks (c) Optimise memory usage only (d) Test for security vulnerabilities
